knowledge.title: One role versus broad capability
knowledge.person: One person usually brings experience and training for one main position.
knowledge.agent: One custom agent can combine broad knowledge and use many connected digital tools.

training.title: Your rules checked every time
training.person: People need paid training, practice, reminders, and retraining as procedures change.
training.agent: The agent checks each job against your rules, corrects failures, and checks again before delivery.

availability.title: Work does not have to wait
availability.person: Sick days, vacations, lateness, and family emergencies can interrupt the work.
availability.agent: The agent can keep approved digital work moving around the clock.

cost.title: Real employee costs keep coming
cost.person: Wages, payroll taxes, workers’ compensation, recruiting, paid training, and retraining.
cost.agent: Custom build, software, maintenance, and updates—without recurring employee costs.

management.title: Manage the work—not the people problems
management.person: Scheduling changes, staff conflict, turnover, replacement, and personnel paperwork take the owner’s time.
management.agent: No staff disputes, call-outs, or turnover. Maintain and update the system as the business changes.

work.title: From unfinished tasks to finished work
work.person: One person switches between jobs. Delays and rework pile up.
work.agent: The agent completes every step, checks the work, corrects failures, and delivers the finished result.
